positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationVerification
positions.frame: how was the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration established and verified?
positions.why: src-1 asserts the calibration at 88.4 MHz; src-2 asserts verification against June reference plates across the full observing band; src-3 and src-4 are the declarative metadata that records the same instrument and calibration facts. The frame holds both the assertive witness voice (Ashgrove's claims) and the session's declarative restatement, with the tension between spoken assertion and recorded metadata left unresolved.
